benchmark.name: OWASP Benchmark
benchmark.source: Offline OWASP-shaped fixture. Set CYBERSTITCH_OWASP_ROOT to a real OWASP Benchmark checkout for live runs.

selection_policy: Manual subset for validating Java CodeQL SQIR/FCIR abstraction over remote-input sources and CWE-78/CWE-89 sinks; this manifest is intentionally not an all-CWE sampler.

cases.rationale: Direct servlet parameter flow into Runtime.exec keeps the source and command sink structure visible for SQIR role extraction.
Constant command execution is a negative control for manifest scoring and SARIF normalization.
Servlet parameter concatenated into Statement.execute exercises a reusable remote source and SQL execution sink predicate.
cases.abstraction_target: RemoteFlowSource plus java.sql.Statement execution argument sink

cases.rationale: PreparedStatement parameter binding is a negative control for the SQL sink family.
